726:   # The animation shown over a thrown Poké Ball when it has successfully caught
727:   # a Pokémon.
728:   def ballCaptureSuccess(ball, delay, ballX, ballY)
729:     ball.setSE(delay, "Battle catch click")
730:     ball.moveTone(delay, 4, Tone.new(-128, -128, -128))   # Ball goes darker
731:     delay = ball.totalDuration
732:     star_duration = 12   # In 20ths of a second
733:     y_offsets = [[0, 74, 52], [0, 62, 28], [0, 74, 48]]
734:     3.times do |i|   # Left, middle, right
735:       # Set up particle
736:       star = addNewSprite(ballX, ballY, "Graphics/Battle animations/ballBurst_star", PictureOrigin::CENTER)
737:       star.setZ(0, 110)
738:       star.setZoom(0, [50, 50, 33][i])
739:       start_angle = [0, 345, 15][i]
740:       star.setAngle(0, start_angle)
741:       star.setOpacity(0, 0)
742:       star.setVisible(0, false)
743:       # Particle animation
744:       star.setVisible(delay, true)
745:       y_pos = y_offsets[i]
746:       star_duration.times do |j|
747:         index = j + 1
748:         x = 72 * index / star_duration
749:         proportion = index.to_f / star_duration
750:         a = (2 * y_pos[2]) - (4 * y_pos[1])
751:         b = y_pos[2] - a
752:         y = ((a * proportion) + b) * proportion
753:         star.moveXY(delay + j, 1, ballX + ([-1, 0, 1][i] * x), ballY - y)
754:       end

1: #===============================================================================
2: #
3: #===============================================================================
4: class IntroEventScene < EventScene
5:   # Splash screen images that appear for a few seconds and then disappear.
6:   SPLASH_IMAGES         = ["splash1", "splash2"]
7:   # The main title screen background image.
8:   TITLE_BG_IMAGE        = "title"
9:   TITLE_START_IMAGE     = "start"
10:   TITLE_START_IMAGE_X   = 0
11:   TITLE_START_IMAGE_Y   = 322
12:   SECONDS_PER_SPLASH    = 2
13:   TICKS_PER_ENTER_FLASH = 40   # 20 ticks per second
14:   FADE_TICKS            = 8    # 20 ticks per second
15: 
16:   def initialize(viewport = nil)
17:     super(viewport)
18:     @pic = addImage(0, 0, "")
19:     @pic.setOpacity(0, 0)        # set opacity to 0 after waiting 0 frames
20:     @pic2 = addImage(0, 0, "")   # flashing "Press Enter" picture
21:     @pic2.setOpacity(0, 0)       # set opacity to 0 after waiting 0 frames
22:     @index = 0
23:     if SPLASH_IMAGES.empty?
24:       open_title_screen(self, nil)
25:     else
26:       open_splash(self, nil)
27:     end
28:   end
29: 
30:   def open_splash(_scene, *args)
31:     onCTrigger.clear
32:     @pic.name = "Graphics/Titles/" + SPLASH_IMAGES[@index]
33:     # fade to opacity 255 in FADE_TICKS ticks after waiting 0 frames
34:     @pic.moveOpacity(0, FADE_TICKS, 255)
35:     pictureWait
36:     @timer = System.uptime                  # reset the timer
37:     onUpdate.set(method(:splash_update))    # called every frame
38:     onCTrigger.set(method(:close_splash))   # called when C key is pressed
39:   end
40: 
41:   def close_splash(scene, args)
42:     onUpdate.clear
43:     onCTrigger.clear
44:     @pic.moveOpacity(0, FADE_TICKS, 0)
45:     pictureWait
46:     @index += 1   # Move to the next picture
47:     if @index >= SPLASH_IMAGES.length
48:       open_title_screen(scene, args)
49:     else
50:       open_splash(scene, args)
51:     end
52:   end
53: 
54:   def splash_update(scene, args)
55:     close_splash(scene, args) if System.uptime - @timer >= SECONDS_PER_SPLASH
56:   end
57: 
58:   def open_title_screen(_scene, *args)
59:     onUpdate.clear
60:     onCTrigger.clear
61:     @pic.name = "Graphics/Titles/" + TITLE_BG_IMAGE
62:     @pic.moveOpacity(0, FADE_TICKS, 255)
63:     @pic2.name = "Graphics/Titles/" + TITLE_START_IMAGE
64:     @pic2.setXY(0, TITLE_START_IMAGE_X, TITLE_START_IMAGE_Y)
65:     @pic2.setVisible(0, true)
66:     @pic2.moveOpacity(0, FADE_TICKS, 255)
67:     pictureWait
68:     pbBGMPlay($data_system.title_bgm)
69:     onUpdate.set(method(:title_screen_update))    # called every frame
70:     onCTrigger.set(method(:close_title_screen))   # called when C key is pressed
71:   end
72: 
73:   def fade_out_title_screen(scene)
74:     onUpdate.clear
75:     onCTrigger.clear
76:     # Play random cry
77:     species_keys = GameData::Species.keys
78:     species_data = GameData::Species.get(species_keys.sample)
79:     Pokemon.play_cry(species_data.species, species_data.form)
80:     @pic.moveXY(0, 20, 0, 0)   # Adds 20 ticks (1 second) pause
81:     pictureWait
82:     # Fade out
83:     @pic.moveOpacity(0, FADE_TICKS, 0)
84:     @pic2.clearProcesses
85:     @pic2.moveOpacity(0, FADE_TICKS, 0)
86:     pbBGMStop(1.0)
87:     pictureWait
88:     scene.dispose   # Close the scene
89:   end
90: 
91:   def close_title_screen(scene, *args)
92:     fade_out_title_screen(scene)
93:     sscene = PokemonLoad_Scene.new
94:     sscreen = PokemonLoadScreen.new(sscene)
95:     sscreen.pbStartLoadScreen
96:   end
97:

99:     fade_out_title_screen(scene)
100:     sscene = PokemonLoad_Scene.new
101:     sscreen = PokemonLoadScreen.new(sscene)
102:     sscreen.pbStartDeleteScreen
103:   end

108:       @pic2.moveOpacity(TICKS_PER_ENTER_FLASH * 2 / 10, TICKS_PER_ENTER_FLASH * 4 / 10, 0)
109:       @pic2.moveOpacity(TICKS_PER_ENTER_FLASH * 6 / 10, TICKS_PER_ENTER_FLASH * 4 / 10, 255)

116:   end

54: class EnumOption

66:     index = current + 1
67:     index = @values.length - 1 if index > @values.length - 1
68:     return index
69:   end

73:     index = 0 if index < 0

81: class NumberOption
82:   include PropertyMixin
83:   attr_reader :lowest_value
84:   attr_reader :highest_value
85: 
86:   def initialize(name, range, get_proc, set_proc)
87:     @name = name
88:     case range
89:     when Range
90:       @lowest_value  = range.begin
91:       @highest_value = range.end
92:     when Array
93:       @lowest_value  = range[0]
94:       @highest_value = range[1]
95:     end
96:     @get_proc = get_proc
97:     @set_proc = set_proc
98:   end
99: 
100:   def next(current)
101:     index = current + @lowest_value
102:     index += 1
103:     index = @lowest_value if index > @highest_value
104:     return index - @lowest_value
105:   end
106: 
107:   def prev(current)
108:     index = current + @lowest_value
109:     index -= 1
110:     index = @highest_value if index < @lowest_value
111:     return index - @lowest_value
112:   end
113: end

118: class SliderOption
119:   include PropertyMixin
120:   attr_reader :lowest_value
121:   attr_reader :highest_value
122: 
123:   def initialize(name, range, get_proc, set_proc)
124:     @name          = name
125:     @lowest_value  = range[0]
126:     @highest_value = range[1]
127:     @interval      = range[2]
128:     @get_proc      = get_proc
129:     @set_proc      = set_proc
130:   end
131: 
132:   def next(current)
133:     index = current + @lowest_value
134:     index += @interval
135:     index = @highest_value if index > @highest_value
136:     return index - @lowest_value
137:   end
138: 
139:   def prev(current)
140:     index = current + @lowest_value
141:     index -= @interval
142:     index = @lowest_value if index < @lowest_value
143:     return index - @lowest_value
144:   end
145: end

157: 
158:   def initialize(options, x, y, width, height)
159:     @options = options
160:     @values = []
161:     @options.length.times { |i| @values[i] = 0 }
162:     @value_changed = false
163:     super(x, y, width, height)
164:   end

166:   def [](i)
167:     return @values[i]
168:   end

172:     refresh

175:   def setValueNoRefresh(i, value)
176:     @values[i] = value
177:   end

179:   def itemCount
180:     return @options.length + 1

182: 
183:   def drawItem(index, _count, rect)
184:     rect = drawCursor(index, rect)
185:     sel_index = self.index
186:     # Draw option's name
187:     optionname = (index == @options.length) ? _INTL("Close") : @options[index].name
188:     optionwidth = rect.width * 9 / 20
189:     pbDrawShadowText(self.contents, rect.x, rect.y, optionwidth, rect.height, optionname,
190:                      (index == sel_index) ? SEL_NAME_BASE_COLOR : self.baseColor,
191:                      (index == sel_index) ? SEL_NAME_SHADOW_COLOR : self.shadowColor)
192:     return if index == @options.length
193:     # Draw option's values
194:     case @options[index]
195:     when EnumOption
196:       if @options[index].values.length > 1
197:         totalwidth = 0
198:         @options[index].values.each do |value|
199:           totalwidth += self.contents.text_size(value).width
200:         end
201:         spacing = (rect.width - rect.x - optionwidth - totalwidth) / (@options[index].values.length - 1)
202:         spacing = 0 if spacing < 0
203:         xpos = optionwidth + rect.x
204:         ivalue = 0
205:         @options[index].values.each do |value|
206:           pbDrawShadowText(self.contents, xpos, rect.y, optionwidth, rect.height, value,
207:                            (ivalue == self[index]) ? SEL_VALUE_BASE_COLOR : self.baseColor,
208:                            (ivalue == self[index]) ? SEL_VALUE_SHADOW_COLOR : self.shadowColor)
209:           xpos += self.contents.text_size(value).width
210:           xpos += spacing
211:           ivalue += 1
212:         end
213:       else
214:         pbDrawShadowText(self.contents, rect.x + optionwidth, rect.y, optionwidth, rect.height,
215:                          optionname, self.baseColor, self.shadowColor)
216:       end
217:     when NumberOption
218:       value = _INTL("Type {1}/{2}", @options[index].lowest_value + self[index],
219:                     @options[index].highest_value - @options[index].lowest_value + 1)
220:       xpos = optionwidth + (rect.x * 2)
221:       pbDrawShadowText(self.contents, xpos, rect.y, optionwidth, rect.height, value,
222:                        SEL_VALUE_BASE_COLOR, SEL_VALUE_SHADOW_COLOR, 1)
223:     when SliderOption
224:       value = sprintf(" %d", @options[index].highest_value)
225:       sliderlength = rect.width - rect.x - optionwidth - self.contents.text_size(value).width
226:       xpos = optionwidth + rect.x
227:       self.contents.fill_rect(xpos, rect.y - 2 + (rect.height / 2), sliderlength, 4, self.baseColor)
228:       self.contents.fill_rect(
229:         xpos + ((sliderlength - 8) * (@options[index].lowest_value + self[index]) / @options[index].highest_value),
230:         rect.y - 8 + (rect.height / 2),
231:         8, 16, SEL_VALUE_BASE_COLOR
232:       )
233:       value = (@options[index].lowest_value + self[index]).to_s
234:       xpos += (rect.width - rect.x - optionwidth) - self.contents.text_size(value).width
235:       pbDrawShadowText(self.contents, xpos, rect.y, optionwidth, rect.height, value,
236:                        SEL_VALUE_BASE_COLOR, SEL_VALUE_SHADOW_COLOR)
237:     else
238:       value = @options[index].values[self[index]]
239:       xpos = optionwidth + rect.x
240:       pbDrawShadowText(self.contents, xpos, rect.y, optionwidth, rect.height, value,
241:                        SEL_VALUE_BASE_COLOR, SEL_VALUE_SHADOW_COLOR)
242:     end
243:   end
244: 
245:   def update
246:     oldindex = self.index
247:     @value_changed = false
248:     super
249:     dorefresh = (self.index != oldindex)
250:     if self.active && self.index < @options.length
251:       if Input.repeat?(Input::LEFT)
252:         self[self.index] = @options[self.index].prev(self[self.index])
253:         dorefresh = true
254:         @value_changed = true
255:       elsif Input.repeat?(Input::RIGHT)
256:         self[self.index] = @options[self.index].next(self[self.index])
257:         dorefresh = true
258:         @value_changed = true
259:       end
260:     end
261:     refresh if dorefresh
262:   end
263: end

253:     end

255:     @scene.pbStartScene(commands)
256:     loop do
257:       command = @scene.pbShowCommands
258:       break if command == -1
259:       if command[0] == 0   # Use a move
260:         move = commands[0][command[1]][0]
261:         user = $player.party[commands[0][command[1]][3]]
262:         if move == :FLY

584:   def pbMoveCursor
585:     oldcursor = @cursorpos
586:     cursordiv = @cursorpos / ROWS   # The row the cursor is in
587:     cursormod = @cursorpos % ROWS   # The column the cursor is in
588:     cursororigin = @cursorpos - cursormod
589:     if Input.repeat?(Input::LEFT)
590:       if @cursorpos < 0   # Controls
591:         @cursorpos -= 1
592:         @cursorpos = OK if @cursorpos < MODE1
593:       else
594:         loop do
595:           cursormod = wrapmod(cursormod - 1, ROWS)
596:           @cursorpos = cursororigin + cursormod
597:           break unless pbColumnEmpty?(cursormod)
598:         end
599:       end
600:     elsif Input.repeat?(Input::RIGHT)
601:       if @cursorpos < 0   # Controls
602:         @cursorpos += 1
603:         @cursorpos = MODE1 if @cursorpos > OK
604:       else
605:         loop do
606:           cursormod = wrapmod(cursormod + 1, ROWS)
607:           @cursorpos = cursororigin + cursormod
608:           break unless pbColumnEmpty?(cursormod)
609:         end
610:       end
611:     elsif Input.repeat?(Input::UP)
612:       if @cursorpos < 0         # Controls
613:         case @cursorpos
614:         when MODE1 then @cursorpos = ROWS * (COLUMNS - 1)
615:         when MODE2 then @cursorpos = (ROWS * (COLUMNS - 1)) + 2
616:         when MODE3 then @cursorpos = (ROWS * (COLUMNS - 1)) + 4
617:         when MODE4 then @cursorpos = (ROWS * (COLUMNS - 1)) + 6
618:         when BACK  then @cursorpos = (ROWS * (COLUMNS - 1)) + 9
619:         when OK    then @cursorpos = (ROWS * (COLUMNS - 1)) + 11
620:         end
621:       elsif @cursorpos < ROWS   # Top row of letters
622:         case @cursorpos
623:         when 0, 1     then @cursorpos = MODE1
624:         when 2, 3     then @cursorpos = MODE2
625:         when 4, 5     then @cursorpos = MODE3
626:         when 6, 7     then @cursorpos = MODE4
627:         when 8, 9, 10 then @cursorpos = BACK
628:         when 11, 12   then @cursorpos = OK
629:         end
630:       else
631:         cursordiv = wrapmod(cursordiv - 1, COLUMNS)
632:         @cursorpos = (cursordiv * ROWS) + cursormod
633:       end
634:     elsif Input.repeat?(Input::DOWN)
635:       if @cursorpos < 0                      # Controls
636:         case @cursorpos
637:         when MODE1 then @cursorpos = 0
638:         when MODE2 then @cursorpos = 2
639:         when MODE3 then @cursorpos = 4
640:         when MODE4 then @cursorpos = 6
641:         when BACK  then @cursorpos = 9
642:         when OK    then @cursorpos = 11
643:         end
644:       elsif @cursorpos >= ROWS * (COLUMNS - 1)   # Bottom row of letters
645:         case cursormod
646:         when 0, 1     then @cursorpos = MODE1
647:         when 2, 3     then @cursorpos = MODE2
648:         when 4, 5     then @cursorpos = MODE3
649:         when 6, 7     then @cursorpos = MODE4
650:         when 8, 9, 10 then @cursorpos = BACK
651:         else               @cursorpos = OK
652:         end
653:       else
654:         cursordiv = wrapmod(cursordiv + 1, COLUMNS)
655:         @cursorpos = (cursordiv * ROWS) + cursormod
656:       end
657:     end
658:     if @cursorpos != oldcursor   # Cursor position changed
659:       @sprites["cursor"].setCursorPos(@cursorpos)
660:       pbPlayCursorSE
661:       return true
662:     end
663:     return false
664:   end

666:   def pbEntry

682:       elsif Input.trigger?(Input::USE)
683:         case @cursorpos

686:           pbPlayCancelSE
687:           pbUpdateOverlay
688:         when OK     # Done

695:           pbChangeTab(0) if @mode != 0

697:           pbChangeTab(1) if @mode != 1
698:         when MODE3

704:           cursordiv = @cursorpos / ROWS

706:           chset = @@Characters[@mode][0]

716:           pbChangeTab(1) if @mode == 0 && @helper.cursor == 1

718:       end
719:     end

190:     if @decision != 0   # Battle ended, stop choosing actions

198:   def pbCommandPhaseLoop(isPlayer)
199:     # NOTE: Doing some things (e.g. running, throwing a Poké Ball) takes up all
200:     #       your actions in a round.
201:     actioned = []
202:     idxBattler = -1
203:     loop do
204:       break if @decision != 0   # Battle ended, stop choosing actions
205:       idxBattler += 1
206:       break if idxBattler >= @battlers.length
207:       next if !@battlers[idxBattler] || pbOwnedByPlayer?(idxBattler) != isPlayer
208:       if @choices[idxBattler][0] != :None || !pbCanShowCommands?(idxBattler)
209:         # Action is forced, can't choose one
210:         PBDebug.log_ai("#{@battlers[idxBattler].pbThis} (#{idxBattler}) is forced to use a multi-turn move")
211:         next
212:       end
213:       # AI controls this battler
214:       if @controlPlayer || !pbOwnedByPlayer?(idxBattler)
215:         @battleAI.pbDefaultChooseEnemyCommand(idxBattler)
216:         next
217:       end
218:       # Player chooses an action
219:       actioned.push(idxBattler)
220:       commandsEnd = false   # Whether to cancel choosing all other actions this round
221:       loop do
222:         cmd = pbCommandMenu(idxBattler, actioned.length == 1)
223:         # If being Sky Dropped, can't do anything except use a move
224:         if cmd > 0 && @battlers[idxBattler].effects[PBEffects::SkyDrop] >= 0
225:           pbDisplay(_INTL("Sky Drop won't let {1} go!", @battlers[idxBattler].pbThis(true)))
226:           next
227:         end
228:         case cmd
229:         when 0    # Fight
230:           break if pbFightMenu(idxBattler)
231:         when 1    # Bag
232:           if pbItemMenu(idxBattler, actioned.length == 1)
233:             commandsEnd = true if pbItemUsesAllActions?(@choices[idxBattler][1])
234:             break
235:           end
236:         when 2    # Pokémon
237:           break if pbPartyMenu(idxBattler)
238:         when 3    # Run
239:           # NOTE: "Run" is only an available option for the first battler the
240:           #       player chooses an action for in a round. Attempting to run
241:           #       from battle prevents you from choosing any other actions in
242:           #       that round.
243:           if pbRunMenu(idxBattler)
244:             commandsEnd = true
245:             break
246:           end
247:         when 4    # Call
248:           break if pbCallMenu(idxBattler)
249:         when -2   # Debug
250:           pbDebugMenu
251:           next
252:         when -1   # Go back to previous battler's action choice
253:           next if actioned.length <= 1
254:           actioned.pop   # Forget this battler was done
255:           idxBattler = actioned.last - 1
256:           pbCancelChoice(idxBattler + 1)   # Clear the previous battler's choice
257:           actioned.pop   # Forget the previous battler was done
258:           break
259:         end
260:         pbCancelChoice(idxBattler)
261:       end
262:       break if commandsEnd
263:     end
264:   end

204:   # Calculate how many shakes a thrown Poké Ball will make (4 = capture)
205:   #=============================================================================
206:   def pbCaptureCalc(pkmn, battler, catch_rate, ball)
207:     return 4 if $DEBUG && Input.press?(Input::CTRL)
208:     # Get a catch rate if one wasn't provided
209:     catch_rate = pkmn.species_data.catch_rate if !catch_rate
210:     # Modify catch_rate depending on the Poké Ball's effect
211:     if !pkmn.species_data.has_flag?("UltraBeast") || ball == :BEASTBALL
212:       catch_rate = Battle::PokeBallEffects.modifyCatchRate(ball, catch_rate, self, battler)
213:     else
214:       catch_rate /= 10
215:     end
216:     # First half of the shakes calculation
217:     a = battler.totalhp
218:     b = battler.hp
219:     x = (((3 * a) - (2 * b)) * catch_rate.to_f) / (3 * a)
220:     # Calculation modifiers
221:     if battler.status == :SLEEP || battler.status == :FROZEN
222:       x *= 2.5
223:     elsif battler.status != :NONE
224:       x *= 1.5
225:     end
226:     x = x.floor
227:     x = 1 if x < 1
228:     # Definite capture, no need to perform randomness checks
229:     return 4 if x >= 255 || Battle::PokeBallEffects.isUnconditional?(ball, self, battler)
230:     # Second half of the shakes calculation
231:     y = (65_536 / ((255.0 / x)**0.1875)).floor
232:     # Critical capture check
233:     if Settings::ENABLE_CRITICAL_CAPTURES
234:       dex_modifier = 0
235:       numOwned = $player.pokedex.owned_count
236:       if numOwned > 600
237:         dex_modifier = 5
238:       elsif numOwned > 450
239:         dex_modifier = 4
240:       elsif numOwned > 300
241:         dex_modifier = 3
242:       elsif numOwned > 150
243:         dex_modifier = 2
244:       elsif numOwned > 30
245:         dex_modifier = 1
246:       end
247:       dex_modifier *= 2 if $bag.has?(:CATCHINGCHARM)
248:       c = x * dex_modifier / 12
249:       # Calculate the number of shakes
250:       if c > 0 && pbRandom(256) < c
251:         @criticalCapture = true
252:         return 4 if pbRandom(65_536) < y
253:         return 0
254:       end
255:     end
256:     # Calculate the number of shakes
257:     numShakes = 0
258:     4.times do |i|
259:       break if numShakes < i
260:       numShakes += 1 if pbRandom(65_536) < y
261:     end
262:     return numShakes
263:   end

130:   # For choosing a replacement Pokémon when prompted in the middle of other
131:   # things happening (U-turn, Baton Pass, in def pbEORSwitch).
132:   def pbSwitchInBetween(idxBattler, checkLaxOnly = false, canCancel = false)
133:     return pbPartyScreen(idxBattler, checkLaxOnly, canCancel) if !@controlPlayer && pbOwnedByPlayer?(idxBattler)
134:     return @battleAI.pbDefaultChooseNewEnemy(idxBattler)

137:   #=============================================================================
138:   # Switching Pokémon
139:   #=============================================================================
140:   # General switching method that checks if any Pokémon need to be sent out and,
141:   # if so, does. Called at the end of each round.
142:   def pbEORSwitch(favorDraws = false)
143:     return if @decision > 0 && !favorDraws
144:     return if @decision == 5 && favorDraws
145:     pbJudge
146:     return if @decision > 0
147:     # Check through each fainted battler to see if that spot can be filled.
148:     switched = []
149:     loop do
150:       switched.clear
151:       @battlers.each do |b|
152:         next if !b || !b.fainted?
153:         idxBattler = b.index
154:         next if !pbCanChooseNonActive?(idxBattler)
155:         if !pbOwnedByPlayer?(idxBattler)   # Opponent/ally is switching in
156:           next if b.wild?   # Wild Pokémon can't switch
157:           idxPartyNew = pbSwitchInBetween(idxBattler)
158:           opponent = pbGetOwnerFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
159:           # NOTE: The player is only offered the chance to switch their own
160:           #       Pokémon when an opponent replaces a fainted Pokémon in single
161:           #       battles. In double battles, etc. there is no such offer.
162:           if @internalBattle && @switchStyle && trainerBattle? && pbSideSize(0) == 1 &&
163:              opposes?(idxBattler) && !@battlers[0].fainted? && !switched.include?(0) &&
164:              pbCanChooseNonActive?(0) && @battlers[0].effects[PBEffects::Outrage] == 0
165:             idxPartyForName = idxPartyNew
166:             enemyParty = pbParty(idxBattler)
167:             if enemyParty[idxPartyNew].ability == :ILLUSION && !pbCheckGlobalAbility(:NEUTRALIZINGGAS)
168:               new_index = pbLastInTeam(idxBattler)
169:               idxPartyForName = new_index if new_index >= 0 && new_index != idxPartyNew
170:             end
171:             if pbDisplayConfirm(_INTL("{1} is about to send out {2}. Will you switch your Pokémon?",
172:                                       opponent.full_name, enemyParty[idxPartyForName].name))
173:               idxPlayerPartyNew = pbSwitchInBetween(0, false, true)
174:               if idxPlayerPartyNew >= 0
175:                 pbMessageOnRecall(@battlers[0])
176:                 pbRecallAndReplace(0, idxPlayerPartyNew)
177:                 switched.push(0)
178:               end
179:             end
180:           end
181:           pbRecallAndReplace(idxBattler, idxPartyNew)
182:           switched.push(idxBattler)
183:         elsif trainerBattle?   # Player switches in in a trainer battle
184:           idxPlayerPartyNew = pbGetReplacementPokemonIndex(idxBattler)   # Owner chooses
185:           pbRecallAndReplace(idxBattler, idxPlayerPartyNew)

194:           if switch

206:   def pbGetReplacementPokemonIndex(idxBattler, random = false)
207:     if random
208:       choices = []   # Find all Pokémon that can switch in
209:       eachInTeamFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler) do |_pkmn, i|
210:         choices.push(i) if pbCanSwitchIn?(idxBattler, i)
211:       end
212:       return -1 if choices.length == 0
213:       return choices[pbRandom(choices.length)]
214:     else

219:   # Actually performs the recalling and sending out in all situations.
220:   def pbRecallAndReplace(idxBattler, idxParty, randomReplacement = false, batonPass = false)
221:     @scene.pbRecall(idxBattler) if !@battlers[idxBattler].fainted?
222:     @battlers[idxBattler].pbAbilitiesOnSwitchOut   # Inc. primordial weather check
223:     @scene.pbShowPartyLineup(idxBattler & 1) if pbSideSize(idxBattler) == 1
224:     pbMessagesOnReplace(idxBattler, idxParty) if !randomReplacement
225:     pbReplace(idxBattler, idxParty, batonPass)

228:   def pbMessageOnRecall(battler)
229:     if battler.pbOwnedByPlayer?
230:       if battler.hp <= battler.totalhp / 4
231:         pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("Good job, {1}! Come back!", battler.name))
232:       elsif battler.hp <= battler.totalhp / 2
233:         pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("OK, {1}! Come back!", battler.name))
234:       elsif battler.turnCount >= 5
235:         pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("{1}, that's enough! Come back!", battler.name))
236:       elsif battler.turnCount >= 2
237:         pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("{1}, come back!", battler.name))
238:       else
239:         pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("{1}, switch out! Come back!", battler.name))
240:       end
241:     else
242:       owner = pbGetOwnerName(battler.index)
243:       pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("{1} withdrew {2}!", owner, battler.name))
244:     end
245:   end

247:   # Only called from def pbRecallAndReplace and Battle Arena's def pbSwitch.
248:   def pbMessagesOnReplace(idxBattler, idxParty)
249:     party = pbParty(idxBattler)
250:     newPkmnName = party[idxParty].name
251:     if party[idxParty].ability == :ILLUSION && !pbCheckGlobalAbility(:NEUTRALIZINGGAS)
252:       new_index = pbLastInTeam(idxBattler)
253:       newPkmnName = party[new_index].name if new_index >= 0 && new_index != idxParty
254:     end
255:     if pbOwnedByPlayer?(idxBattler)
256:       opposing = @battlers[idxBattler].pbDirectOpposing
257:       if opposing.fainted? || opposing.hp == opposing.totalhp
258:         pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("You're in charge, {1}!", newPkmnName))
259:       elsif opposing.hp >= opposing.totalhp / 2
260:         pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("Go for it, {1}!", newPkmnName))
261:       elsif opposing.hp >= opposing.totalhp / 4
262:         pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("Just a little more! Hang in there, {1}!", newPkmnName))
263:       else
264:         pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("Your opponent's weak! Get 'em, {1}!", newPkmnName))
265:       end
266:     else
267:       owner = pbGetOwnerFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
268:       pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("{1} sent out {2}!", owner.full_name, newPkmnName))
269:     end

272:   # Only called from def pbRecallAndReplace above and Battle Arena's def
273:   # pbSwitch.
274:   def pbReplace(idxBattler, idxParty, batonPass = false)
275:     party = pbParty(idxBattler)
276:     idxPartyOld = @battlers[idxBattler].pokemonIndex
277:     # Initialise the new Pokémon
278:     @battlers[idxBattler].pbInitialize(party[idxParty], idxParty, batonPass)
279:     # Reorder the party for this battle
280:     partyOrder = pbPartyOrder(idxBattler)
281:     partyOrder[idxParty], partyOrder[idxPartyOld] = partyOrder[idxPartyOld], partyOrder[idxParty]
282:     # Send out the new Pokémon
283:     pbSendOut([[idxBattler, party[idxParty]]])
284:     pbCalculatePriority(false, [idxBattler]) if Settings::RECALCULATE_TURN_ORDER_AFTER_SPEED_CHANGES
285:   end

287:   # Called from def pbReplace above and at the start of battle.
288:   # sendOuts is an array; each element is itself an array: [idxBattler,pkmn]
289:   def pbSendOut(sendOuts, startBattle = false)
290:     sendOuts.each { |b| @peer.pbOnEnteringBattle(self, @battlers[b[0]], b[1]) }
291:     @scene.pbSendOutBattlers(sendOuts, startBattle)
292:     sendOuts.each do |b|

294:       pbSetSeen(@battlers[b[0]])
295:       @usedInBattle[b[0] & 1][b[0] / 2] = true
296:     end

299:   #=============================================================================
300:   # Effects upon a Pokémon entering battle
301:   #=============================================================================
302:   # Called at the start of battle only.
303:   def pbOnAllBattlersEnteringBattle
304:     pbCalculatePriority(true)
305:     battler_indices = []
306:     allBattlers.each { |b| battler_indices.push(b.index) }
307:     pbOnBattlerEnteringBattle(battler_indices)
308:     pbCalculatePriority

313:   # Called when one or more Pokémon switch in. Does a lot of things, including
314:   # entry hazards, form changes and items/abilities that trigger upon switching
315:   # in.
316:   def pbOnBattlerEnteringBattle(battler_index, skip_event_reset = false)
317:     battler_index = [battler_index] if !battler_index.is_a?(Array)
318:     battler_index.flatten!
319:     # NOTE: This isn't done for switch commands, because they previously call
320:     #       pbRecallAndReplace, which could cause Neutralizing Gas to end, which
321:     #       in turn could cause Intimidate to trigger another Pokémon's Eject
322:     #       Pack. That Eject Pack should trigger at the end of this method, but
323:     #       this resetting would prevent that from happening, so it is skipped
324:     #       and instead done earlier in def pbAttackPhaseSwitch.
325:     if !skip_event_reset
326:       allBattlers.each do |b|
327:         b.droppedBelowHalfHP = false
328:         b.statsDropped = false
329:       end
330:     end
331:     # For each battler that entered battle, in speed order
332:     pbPriority(true).each do |b|
333:       next if !battler_index.include?(b.index) || b.fainted?
334:       pbRecordBattlerAsParticipated(b)
335:       pbMessagesOnBattlerEnteringBattle(b)
336:       # Position/field effects triggered by the battler appearing
337:       pbEffectsOnBattlerEnteringPosition(b)   # Healing Wish/Lunar Dance
338:       pbEntryHazards(b)

340:       if b.fainted?
341:         b.pbFaint
342:         pbGainExp
343:         pbJudge
344:         next
345:       end
346:       b.pbCheckForm
347:       # Primal Revert upon entering battle
348:       pbPrimalReversion(b.index)
349:       # Ending primordial weather, checking Trace
350:       b.pbContinualAbilityChecks(true)
351:       # Abilities that trigger upon switching in
352:       if (!b.fainted? && b.unstoppableAbility?) || b.abilityActive?
353:         Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerOnSwitchIn(b.ability, b, self, true)
354:       end
355:       pbEndPrimordialWeather   # Checking this again just in case
356:       # Items that trigger upon switching in (Air Balloon message)
357:       if b.itemActive?
358:         Battle::ItemEffects.triggerOnSwitchIn(b.item, b, self)
359:       end
360:       # Berry check, status-curing ability check
361:       b.pbHeldItemTriggerCheck
362:       b.pbAbilityStatusCureCheck
363:     end
364:     # Check for triggering of Emergency Exit/Wimp Out/Eject Pack (only one will
365:     # be triggered)
366:     pbPriority(true).each do |b|
367:       break if b.pbItemOnStatDropped
368:       break if b.pbAbilitiesOnDamageTaken
369:     end
370:     allBattlers.each do |b|
371:       b.droppedBelowHalfHP = false
372:       b.statsDropped = false
373:     end

376:   def pbRecordBattlerAsParticipated(battler)
377:     # Record money-doubling effect of Amulet Coin/Luck Incense

418:         position.effects[PBEffects::LunarDance] = false

421:       end
422:     end

1: #===============================================================================
2: # This module stores events that can happen during the game. A procedure can
3: # subscribe to an event by adding itself to the event. It will then be called
4: # whenever the event occurs. Existing events are:
5: #-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6: #   :on_game_map_setup - When a Game_Map is set up. Typically changes map data.
7: #   :on_new_spriteset_map - When a Spriteset_Map is created. Adds more things to
8: #     show in the overworld.
9: #   :on_frame_update - Once per frame. Various frame/time counters.
10: #   :on_leave_map - When leaving a map. End weather/expired effects.
11: #   :on_enter_map - Upon entering a new map. Set up new effects, end expired
12: #     effects.
13: #   :on_map_or_spriteset_change - Upon entering a new map or when spriteset was
14: #     made. Show things on-screen.
15: #-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
16: #   :on_player_change_direction - When the player turns in a different direction.
17: #   :on_leave_tile - When any event or the player starts to move from a tile.
18: #   :on_step_taken - When any event or the player finishes a step.
19: #   :on_player_step_taken - When the player finishes a step/ends surfing, except
20: #     as part of a move route. Step-based counters.
21: #   :on_player_step_taken_can_transfer - When the player finishes a step/ends
22: #     surfing, except as part of a move route. Step-based effects that can
23: #     transfer the player elsewhere.
24: #   :on_player_interact - When the player presses the Use button in the
25: #     overworld.
26: #-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
27: #   :on_trainer_load - When an NPCTrainer is generated (to battle against or as
28: #     a registered partner). Various modifications to that trainer and their
29: #     Pokémon.
30: #   :on_wild_species_chosen - When a species/level have been chosen for a wild
31: #     encounter. Changes the species/level (e.g. roamer, Poké Radar chain).
32: #   :on_wild_pokemon_created - When a Pokemon object has been created for a wild
33: #     encounter. Various modifications to that Pokémon.
34: #   :on_calling_wild_battle - When a wild battle is called. Prevents that wild
35: #     battle and instead starts a different kind of battle (e.g. Safari Zone).
36: #   :on_start_battle - Just before a battle starts. Memorize/reset information
37: #     about party Pokémon, which is used after battle for evolution checks.
38: #   :on_end_battle - Just after a battle ends. Evolution checks, Pickup/Honey
39: #     Gather, blacking out.
40: #   :on_wild_battle_end - After a wild battle. Updates Poké Radar chain info.
41: #===============================================================================
42: module EventHandlers
43:   @@events = {}
44: 
45:   # Add a named callback for the given event.
46:   def self.add(event, key, proc)
47:     @@events[event] = NamedEvent.new if !@@events.has_key?(event)
48:     @@events[event].add(key, proc)
49:   end
50: 
51:   # Remove a named callback from the given event.
52:   def self.remove(event, key)
53:     @@events[event]&.remove(key)
54:   end
55: 
56:   # Clear all callbacks for the given event.
57:   def self.clear(key)
58:     @@events[key]&.clear
59:   end
60: 
61:   # Trigger all callbacks from an Event if it has been defined.
62:   def self.trigger(event, *args)
63:     return @@events[event]&.trigger(*args)
64:   end
65: end
66: 
67: #===============================================================================
68: # This module stores the contents of various menus. Each command in a menu is a
69: # hash of data (containing its name, relative order, code to run when chosen,
70: # etc.).
71: # Menus that use this module are:
72: #-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
73: # Pause menu
74: # Party screen main interact menu
75: # Pokégear main menu
76: # Options screen
77: # PC main menu
78: # Various debug menus (main, Pokémon, battle, battle Pokémon)
79: #===============================================================================
80: module MenuHandlers
81:   @@handlers = {}
82: 
83:   def self.add(menu, option, hash)
84:     @@handlers[menu] = HandlerHash.new if !@@handlers.has_key?(menu)
85:     @@handlers[menu].add(option, hash)
86:   end
87: 
88:   def self.remove(menu, option)
89:     @@handlers[menu]&.remove(option)
90:   end
91: 
92:   def self.clear(menu)
93:     @@handlers[menu]&.clear
94:   end
95: 
96:   def self.each(menu)
97:     return if !@@handlers.has_key?(menu)
98:     @@handlers[menu].each { |option, hash| yield option, hash }
99:   end
100: 
101:   def self.each_available(menu, *args)
102:     return if !@@handlers.has_key?(menu)
103:     options = @@handlers[menu]
104:     keys = options.keys
105:     sorted_keys = keys.sort_by { |option| options[option]["order"] || keys.index(option) }
106:     sorted_keys.each do |option|
107:       hash = options[option]
108:       next if hash["condition"] && !hash["condition"].call(*args)
109:       if hash["name"].is_a?(Proc)
110:         name = hash["name"].call
111:       else
112:         name = _INTL(hash["name"])
113:       end
114:       yield option, hash, name
115:     end
116:   end
117: 
118:   def self.call(menu, option, function, *args)
119:     option_hash = @@handlers[menu][option]
120:     return nil if !option_hash || !option_hash[function]
121:     return option_hash[function].call(*args)
122:   end
123: end

162:         updateScene
163:       end
164:     end
165:     @sprites["pokemon"].x = targets[targets.length - 1]
166:     @sprites["hatch"].x   = @sprites["pokemon"].x

213:     @sets[set1] = @sets[set2]
